Bhattathiri in opening and closing scenes
continuity.narrative_arc: Eleven consecutive captions guide the view from Krishna’s first youthful divine appearance through hair, eyes, face, flute, chest, waist, thighs, knees, ankles and feet, ending with Bhattathiri’s prayer for forgiveness and well-being.
continuity.reference_mapping: Readiness record maps photos/captions 001–011 one-to-one to stanzas 1–11. Photos 012–015 remain unmapped extras and are not used as stanza sources.
continuity.batch_selection: Eleven native landscape candidates for an unapproved reference-versus-candidate comparison chapter. Portraits are paused. No art approval is implied.
continuity.palette_arc: Flat opaque mineral colors in deep blue, warm cream, earth ochre, maroon, muted olive and painted ochre ornament. Keep local blue lilies and flower accents restrained. No glossy highlights, metallic gold or cinematic beams.
continuity.krishna_form_contract: Use the shared krishna-vrindavan-youth contract for the youthful divine form: deep matte indigo-blue skin, long dark curls, yellow dhoti, muted red-orange shawl, one simple low gold band with one upright peacock feather, smooth bare forehead, one face, two arms and natural human proportions. The caption and Sanskrit for stanza 2 mention a forehead mark; preserve that source wording but omit the mark from the visual to honor the established youthful identity.

must_show: Bhattathiri experiences the nectar-like first vision of Krishna among blue lilies; Narada, sages and personified Upanishad women form a distinct surrounding group.

Center one youthful Krishna in a quiet seated lotus setting with Bhattathiri in prayer. Keep Krishna’s cheek a deep indigo blue with blue-minus-red at least 60. Give Bhattathiri, Narada and all visible attendants clearly brown mineral-pigment skin, not orange or yellow; skin-only human face medians should have red-minus-blue below 100 and must remain below 120. Make Krishna’s open hand show one thumb plus four fingers, and keep the other hand relaxed with all visible digits separately countable.
Keep the full composition native 16:9 and entirely inside the frame, with clear connected anatomy and uncluttered safe margins.
Follow the declared character contracts for all visible figures.
scene_brief.composition: Place Krishna and Bhattathiri as the main figures in the foreground; show Narada and the sages clearly, with the personified Upanishad women as a small, distinct attendant group in the middle distance. Use matte blue lilies and a restrained cream halo, with no rays or beams.
scene_brief.tone: Restrained devotional reverence with clear visual hierarchy.
